prague-bohemian-switzerland-sandstone-ro.title: Prague · Bohemian Switzerland Sandstone Roads
prague-bohemian-switzerland-sandstone-ro.slogan: A 213 km loop out of Mělník river
prague-bohemian-switzerland-sandstone-ro.story: Sandstone walls, river bends and a proper northbound escape. Out of Mělník and back again: 213 km, roughly 3 h 40 in the saddle. On the way it passes Hřensko gorge, Děčín cliffs and Litoměřice. It keeps to quiet secondary roads.
